bioconda.name: hapmeth
bioconda.summary: Per-haplotype 5mC locus plots from haplotagged long-read modBAMs.
bioconda.description:
hapmeth plots CpG 5mC per haplotype from a haplotagged Oxford Nanopore
modBAM or CRAM, at built-in imprinting, X-inactivation and QC loci (hg38
and hs1) or any BED regions. It writes one figure per locus, an overview
figure and a TSV.
